cycles.diagnosis: Long from-import star statements were treated like ordinary import-name lists, so Black inserted optional parentheses and later emitted invalid parenthesized star imports. The same import parenthesis normalization also ran on a # fmt: off import, removing user-preserved parentheses.

file_inspections.reason: Inspected the fixture for the long star import expected to remain a single valid import line.
Inspected the fixture showing parentheses inside a # fmt: off import must be preserved.
Inspected the import-from visitor and line splitting code that inserts invisible parentheses and formats import statements.

patch_attempt.patch_summary: Updated LineGenerator.visit_import_from to skip parenthesis normalization when a # fmt: off marker applies, and to avoid inserting invisible parentheses for from-import star statements.
